notes: 1922 vol 1 plate 13, right half. Gutter overlap with 22-13L: Harrison/Turner, Acorn Alley/Turner and Coppin Street/Turner are picked on both halves (Turner's centre is clamped to x=6024 on 22-13L). Turner/Bank is only on this half. Overlap offset measured by image matching: R x ~ L x - 5490..5533, R y ~ L y - 18..+2 (varies down the gutter). Names as printed: BOGEN STREET, OSWALDT ... STREET (spelled with the final T), COLERAIN AVENUE, W. McMICKEN AVENUE, WARNER and EMMING (printed without suffix, written with 'Street' as on the 1904 sheets), TURNER STREET, ACORN AL., COPPIN / STREET, WINCHELL STREET, KOEBEL STREET, PATTERSON STREET, BELOIT (10 ft, printed without suffix, kept as printed), ANDRESS / ALLEY, KINDEL STREET, KIMPEL / ALLEY, FREEMAN AVE., CENTRAL AVE. Only 'AVENUE' is printed for Queen City Avenue and only 'STREET' for Bank Street on this half; both names from the 1904 sheets. Renamed since 1904 (no bracketed old names seen on the plate): Winchell Avenue -> Winchell Street, Kindel Avenue -> Kindel Street, Turner Alley -> Turner Street, 'Brighton' 10 ft alley -> Beloit, Andrews Alley -> Andress Alley, the Bogen Alley between Kindel and Freeman (1904 sheet 225) -> Kimpel Alley, the 20 ft 'Ernst Alley' of 1904 sheet 224 (Spring Grove to Winchell) -> Coppin Street, Harvis Alley -> Acorn Alley. Brighton corner: Harrison comes in from the west and Central Avenue continues ESE almost on the same line; the south part of Colerain (50 ft, x 3025-3182) leaves southward from that line; recorded as two T entries at (3104,4795) like 1904 sheet 225. The NW-SE diagonal of Colerain enters the open plaza north of that point; its SW side ends at the 2205-2211 block corner (~3030,4565) and its NE side runs on into Central Avenue's north line, so its centreline meets Central about 250 px east at (3346,4856); not recorded as a separate intersection (see the Colerain bend at (3104,4525)). Beloit runs from Patterson to Colerain only; an unnamed alley (printed 'ALLEY') leaves the east side of Colerain about 35 px further south and runs ESE to Freeman, with unnamed N-S alleys to Bank at x~3470 and (Kimpel Alley) x~4206; unnamed alleys are not recorded. Short unnamed passages south of Bank (x~745-781, 2657-2695, 3487-3528, 4129-4162) do not line up with any street and are ignored. Kindel and Freeman start at Central (nothing drawn north of Central there). Coppin Street ends at Winchell. The unnamed 60 ft street that forks SSW from West McMicken at the tip of the lot-209 triangle (~2860,2600) and joins Colerain near (2570,3780) carries a trolley track but no name; its two junctions are not recorded. INCLINE PLANE (east from West McMicken at y~2040) is an incline railway, not a street. RUSH ALLEY (in the canal-bed subdivision east of Colerain, x~2440-2600, y~130-820) meets no street on this half. West McMicken continues ESE off the drawn area at about (3870,3750); the drawn area simply ends there. Harrison is ~60 ft and curves between Winchell and Patterson; the Koebel and Patterson T points are on the curve (centre taken midway between the block lines along the cross street; about +-10 px). The old canal bed, the incline, railroads and the key/scale/compass are ignored.
